title: Net Energy Metering Riders — Applicability, Customer Class and Eligible Generators
content:
Lakeshore Power & Light Company offers Net Energy Metering to customer-owned renewable generation through six riders. This sheet states, for each rider, whether it accepts new applications, the customer class it serves, the entry requirements of the customer and the service agreement, and the generator types it accepts.

## Applicability by rider

| Rider | Open to new applications | Customer class | Entry requirements | Date after which no applications are accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rider NEM-L Legacy Net Energy Metering | No | Residential | Closed rider; it carries only agreements grandfathered on applications made before 2020-04-15 | 2020-04-15 |
| Rider NEM-R Residential Net Energy Metering | Yes | Residential | Residential customer | Not applicable |
| Rider NBT-R Residential Net Billing Tariff | Yes | Residential | Residential customer | Not applicable |
| Rider NBT-C Commercial Net Billing Tariff | Yes | Business | Service agreement on Schedule GS Small General Service, Schedule GST Small General Time-of-Use Service or Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service | Not applicable |
| Rider NEM-A Aggregated Net Energy Metering | Yes | Business | Aggregated service agreements held by the same customer, on contiguous parcels | Not applicable |
| Rider NBT-L Large Customer Net Billing Tariff | Yes | Business | Service agreement on Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service or Schedule LP Large Power Service, with a system of at least 150 kW AC | Not applicable |

## Eligible generator types

| Rider | Generator types accepted |
|---|---|
| Rider NEM-L Legacy Net Energy Metering | Solar photovoltaic; wind |
| Rider NEM-R Residential Net Energy Metering | Solar photovoltaic; solar photovoltaic with storage; wind |
| Rider NBT-R Residential Net Billing Tariff | Solar photovoltaic; solar photovoltaic with storage; wind |
| Rider NBT-C Commercial Net Billing Tariff | Solar photovoltaic; solar photovoltaic with storage; wind |
| Rider NEM-A Aggregated Net Energy Metering | Solar photovoltaic; solar photovoltaic with storage; wind |
| Rider NBT-L Large Customer Net Billing Tariff | Solar photovoltaic; solar photovoltaic with storage; wind |

## Notes to the sheet

- Rider NEM-L Legacy Net Energy Metering is the only closed rider. Its legacy closed date is 2020-04-15; every other rider shows "not applicable" for that date.
- Residential customers choose between the two open residential riders, Rider NEM-R and Rider NBT-R. Business customers fall under Rider NBT-C, Rider NEM-A or Rider NBT-L according to the schedule, aggregation and size requirements in the table.
- Solar photovoltaic with storage is the only generator type that pairs a battery; it is not listed under the legacy rider.
